versions.content: DL field Incoming SF - I frames with an invalid DL value of 0x0 or higher than 0x7 (0x 6 in FRARTP_ISO6 mode ) shall be ignored. This shall also be done if a value arrives which is higher than the amount of payload that can be derived from the length statement of the corresponding PduInfoType struct in the configuration and the addressing mod e.
